classification: Bounded CPU-only high-precision adjudication of three exact source101 capture360 rows. No native execution, production edits, physical acceptance, or full solver qualification.
limits: Only the named three tetrahedra from one rejected Newton capture are analyzed.
No all-nine-direction gate or native FP32 endpoint noise floor is inferred.
MP90/FP64 agreement at these points cannot qualify the material pair, coupled matrix, or a physical run.
Every projection failure and branch change is retained in the epsilon records; no row is filtered by error size.

numerics.branch_fields: multiplier sign, yield sign, and smoothed FB branch selection retained per endpoint
numerics.finite_difference: Perturbed F by epsilon*dt*captured grad(delta_v), then divided stress difference by 2*epsilon*dt to compare with rate-direction tangent.
numerics.fp64_reference: bilinear15_reference.py stock FP64 projector; local stop 2e-10 scaled residual, maxiter 80

input_relation.F_center: captured float32 high+low widened exactly to FP64/MP90
input_relation.accepted_history: captured float32 state held fixed across all projections
input_relation.native_tangent: captured read-only full local 9x9 cache; action compared along same captured rate direction
input_relation.perturbation: F±=Fcenter±epsilon*dt*captured grad(delta_v); finite difference divided by 2 epsilon dt
